usage.marketing_headings: Cormorant Garamond for a premium, trustworthy editorial feel. Use tracking-tight.
usage.dashboard_headings_and_ui: Manrope for pristine legibility, humanist warmth, and data clarity.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-semibold text-slate-900 font-serif
scale.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl tracking-tight font-medium text-slate-900 font-serif
scale.h4: text-lg font-medium text-slate-700 font-sans uppercase tracking-widest

colors.description: Soft blue/green/white palette avoiding AI-slop purple/violet and avoiding generic teal. Organic, clinical, and calming.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Apple-inspired). Use p-8, p-12 for containers. Break the scroll with bento grids.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_layout: Asymmetrical bento boxes, large overlapping images, massive whitespace. Container max-w-7xl.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_layout: Sidebar navigation (w-64), top sticky header (glassmorphism), dense but readable bento grid for metrics.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Rounded corners (rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons and pills).
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Minimalist soft shadows. default: shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgb(0,0,0,0.03)], hover: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.06)].

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90. Secondary uses bg-white border border-border text-slate-700 shadow-sm.
components.cards: White background, rounded-2xl, 1px border-border/50, soft shadow. Internal padding must be p-6 or p-8.
components.health_metric_cards: Top-left: Icon in soft circle. Top-right: Trend badge (green/red). Center: Massive data number (text-4xl). Bottom: Sparkline chart (Recharts).
components.timeline: Vertical left border (border-l-2 border-accent). Dots for events (w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-primary). Left padding pl-6 for content.
components.doctor_cards: Portrait image at top (aspect-square object-cover rounded-t-2xl). Body: p-6. Name in serif, specialty in small_label. Rating and 'Book Consultation' pill.
components.pricing_cards: Bento style. Highlighted tier gets border-primary and primary button. Others get subtle border.
components.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky top navigation and floating toast notifications. bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/50.

visual_enhancers.animations: Framer Motion. Subtle fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0) on scroll. Micro-interactions on hover (scale 1.02 for cards).
visual_enhancers.charts: Use Recharts for Weight/BMI charts. Area charts with gradient fill (from primary/30 to transparent). Keep grid lines extremely subtle (stroke-border/30).
visual_enhancers.glass_effects: backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 for premium Apple feel.

hero_lifestyle.description: Woman enjoying a healthy break indoors by a sunny window. Use for Landing Hero.

doctor_portrait.description: Smiling female doctor in a bright clinical environment. Use for Doctor Directory / Feature.

healthy_food.description: Vegetable dish in white ceramic bowl. Use for Nutrition / Diet Plan section.

fitness_tracking.description: Smartwatch tracking fitness. Use for Patient Dashboard or Progress Tracking section.

tech_stack_recommendations.charts: recharts (for patient dashboard weight/BMI and admin analytics).
tech_stack_recommendations.animations: framer-motion (for page transitions, bento card hover effects).
tech_stack_recommendations.forms: react-hook-form + zod (for assessment wizard and auth).

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Initialize Tailwind with the provided CSS variables. Overwrite the default radius to 1rem.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a robust bento grid system for the dashboards. Avoid standard list views where bento layouts can provide better data visualization.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: For the patient dashboard, focus on the 'Health Metric Cards' and 'Progress Charts'. The design must feel encouraging and clinical.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: For the marketing site, use the Cormorant Garamond font for large, impactful, trustworthy headings.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use generic blue or purple gradients. Stick strictly to the soft Pine/Sage and Slate color palette.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly, primarily on sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button') to facilitate robust automated testing.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx or .jsx.
